notes: «حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي (رحمه الله)»: the compiler's father, named only by relation (rule 7)
«وَ غَيْرِهِ» («and others») is an unnamed co-transmitter in the same level (rule 8); the bracket «[» before «زائد» is in the text and is copied; «مَوْلَى طِرْبَالٍ» is a description and is left out
«قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ (ع)»: the Imam is named in the words after the chain, last link, imam_in_text (owner ruling 2)
